answer: Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The whisper graph is validated at intake and the karst frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and umber anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Forging one identity takes 7 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 583 takes that multiplied out, plus 278 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
